scope: Uniform barycentric subdivisions of only the 86 flagged source faces, evaluated through the unchanged full published transform. Preview patches, not replacement global cortex.
coordinates: Synthetic barycentric points in the original planar triangle; mapped with the same 2015+2019 fields. Local float32 coordinates plus float64 anchor reduce storage rounding.
limits: Positive derivatives at sampled centres do not certify full subtriangle interiors or global injectivity
Subdividing a source planar face is not new histological data or higher anatomical resolution

Numerical rendering gaps are distinct from anatomical AFID residuals
